entities.name: Martín de Aragón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martín de Gurrea y Aragóna was a Spanish nobleman from a royal line descended from John II of Aragon's son Alfonso. He was born and died in Pedrola. He was also notable as a collector and patron of the arts, commissioning artists such as Pablo Esquert.
